subject.title: Tool error messages surfaced to chat should include failure reason and retry confirmation

question: Should OpenClaw surface redacted tool failure reasons and retry/recovery confirmations in user-visible chat, or keep raw failures internal and rely on agent-authored summaries?
rationale: The implementation path is clear, but the safe default depends on maintainer intent for channel trust, redaction, and whether recovered mutating side effects should be reported to humans.

options.title: Add redacted recovery-aware policy
options.body: Surface sanitized actionable reasons and bounded recovered notices only when the channel and tool side-effect state make that safe.

options.title: Keep raw failures internal
options.body: Suppress standalone raw details by default and require the agent or diagnostics surfaces to summarize failures instead.

options.title: Append sanitized reasons only
options.body: Solve failure reason visibility first while leaving retry-success confirmation to the broader native recovery-loop work.

recommendation.title: Add redacted recovery-aware policy
recommendation.body: Surface sanitized actionable reasons and bounded recovered notices only when the channel and tool side-effect state make that safe.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision is primarily product and security policy around channel-visible diagnostics rather than a narrow formatting patch.
